title: Really Soft
text: Really Soft. This throw is really soft, but it looks pretty sad. It gets all weird because the front and back layers aren't quilted or fused in any way. So, it ends up looking like a pile of random fabric. The ribbed side is also not quite right. It isn't ribbed enough to look like corduroy, but it is too ribbed to look normal. It is just such a weird look. The color is also pretty lackluster. Again, it is super soft and cozy-- it just doesn't look great to have sitting around. It came vacuum-packed and looked really bad when it arrived. Once I washed it, it fluffed up and looked better, though still a bit weird.
